description: This file declares an abstract interface class 'dmQuery' with virtual methods for executing and managing data model queries, used in the context of a device management or data provider system.

classes.name: dmQuery
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for executing and managing data model queries.

methods.name: reset
